title: Bug 650344: [Subcontracting] Prevent cancellation of vendor-supplied component lines
summary: Subcontracting planning no longer proposes cancellation actions for vendor-supplied component purchase lines, preventing unintended line removals during regenerative planning.
key_points: Vendor-supplied component lines are excluded from planning supply calculations
Regenerative planning no longer generates Cancel requisition lines for these components
Regression test added to ensure the fix prevents future cancellation proposals
Change affects only subcontracting planning behavior
quote: Exclude vendor-supplied subcontracting component purchase lines from planning supply.
